tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The ST-248 Multifunctional LAN UTP CAT5 CAT6 RJ45 Coaxial Cable and BNC Plugs Tester is a versatile and essential network diagnostic tool designed for technicians, installers, and IT professionals.

This reliable tester supports UTP (CAT5/CAT6), RJ45, RJ11 telephone lines, and BNC coaxial cables, making it ideal for testing continuity, wiring correctness, open circuits, short circuits, and connection integrity. The clear LED indicator system ensures fast and accurate testing results, while the lightweight design allows for easy carrying during on-site networking tasks. Whether you're setting up a new network, troubleshooting cable issues, or maintaining existing infrastructure, the ST-248 delivers accuracy and efficiency for professional networking work in Bangladesh.


Key Features

  • Supports Multiple Cable Types – UTP CAT5/CAT6, RJ45, RJ11, and BNC coaxial cables.
  • LED Indicator Testing – Displays open circuits, shorts, cross-wiring, split pairs, and continuity status.
  • High Testing Accuracy – Ensures reliable diagnostics for network installation and maintenance.
  • Remote Test Capability – Includes a detachable remote unit for long-distance cable testing.
  • Portable & Lightweight Design – Easy to carry and ideal for field technicians.
  • Durable Construction – Built to withstand regular professional use.
  • Wide Application – Suitable for LAN networks, CCTV systems, telephone lines, and data communication projects.
  • User-Friendly Operation – Simple interface designed for both beginners and professionals.
